plotSections.title: Stronghold Gathering
bullets: The party regroups at Langdale Stronghold as Mahali finishes a pork-inspired stew dinner, with Ponchi helping in the kitchen and Gerk pulverizing white tubers in a bucket.
Ord and Ciri come up from the basement, where Ord has taken on a new roommate: Moxie, a semi-sentient beaver-like creature (a 'beaverine'), which Ord has told to hunt outside the keep.
Koji, Bo, and the stone mill mercenaries are holed up in the guard house on their usual patrol-day routine.
Sylan still holds the fused lantern-staff and wants to continue practicing with it.

plotSections.title: Lich Hunt and the Helm
bullets: The DM reminds the party they still have a lich to find and a phylactery to deal with; Ciri suggests destroying the phylactery right away.

Walker reports that the helm examined with Carlkin is not the phylactery, but it holds a small bit of soul, which he describes as an echo of the lich's soul; Ciri and Sylan suspect he is not telling everything.
Walker begins asking whether Carlkin gave them the bag.

chronologicalEvents: Sylan arrives at the stronghold as Ciri and Ord come up from the basement.
Ord announces his new roommate Moxie, a semi-sentient beaverine he fed with Ciri and told to hunt outside the keep; Ponchi also lives with it.
Mahali nears completion of a pork stew dinner, with Ponchi and Gerk helping.
Sylan confirms he still has the fused lantern-staff and wants to keep practicing with it.
The DM reminds the party of the lich and phylactery they must find.
Walker says the helm is not the phylactery but contains a soul echo of the lich.
Walker asks whether Carlkin gave the party the bag.
